protocol.scope: Stage 4 raw candidates -> optional MCTS -> identical fixed BUE -> CBT
protocol.selection: Historical 65-video selection reproduced by max_per_category=5, random_state=42; 60 abnormal and 5 normal; Abuse=2 and Assault=3 due to test-set availability.
protocol.pairing: One shared upstream discovery; off completes before any search. Each active policy independently executes the current MCTS refiner with its own budget/tree and video state.
protocol.api_replay: Per-video exact-request cache: only identical model settings, prompts and image bytes share successful replies. This is a live paired run, not frozen-tree replay.
protocol.frozen: All Stage 4 candidates retained, discovery confidences and predicted categories fixed. Stage 5 and intermediate refinements/top-k/NMS/classification/gating/QSCORE bypassed.
protocol.search: shrink, all_valid, 8 simulations, depth 4, 2 candidates/video, 10 logical requests/candidate and 20/video, 32 evidence images, boundary gap 1.5s/evidence gap 3s.
protocol.evaluation: Current VadCLIP noninterpolated class-aware AP; 13 abnormal classes, native FPS, integer half-open frames, IoU 0.1:0.1:0.5. Normal false positives reported separately.
protocol.costs: Whole-run tokens/latency are actual shared four-arm usage. Later arms benefit from cache; branch time/tokens are not standalone deployment comparisons.
protocol.limitations: 65-video subset, not full test set. Includes earlier pilot inputs; not an independent holdout. Existing CBT priors unchanged; older provenance unverified. GT only used for evaluation.
